job.question: What is the proposal submission deadline in the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System (OPERS) investment consulting services RFP?
job.acceptance: Accept Central Time/CT; explicit equivalent timezone conversion acceptable.

reviews.reason: The document is a Hawaii ERS real assets investment consultant RFP, not the Oklahoma OPERS investment consulting services RFP. Its proposal deadline does not support the deadline asked about.
quotes: Employees’ Retirement System of the State of Hawaii (ERS) Request for Proposals Real Assets Investment Consultant RFP 2022-06 Issued October 3, 2022
Closing Date for Receipt of Proposals November 30, 2022 by 4:30 p.m. (H.S.T.)
